ROOT.scriptdef: IF EXISTS (SELECT Name,xtype FROM sysobjects WHERE Name='POS_TCNDoEksportu' AND xtype in (N'FN', N'IF', N'TF', N'FS', N'FT')) drop function CDN.POS_TCNDoEksportu;

CREATE FUNCTION CDN.POS_TCNDoEksportu(@PointOfSaleId int) RETURNS @TC TABLE (CenaLP int,archiwalny int) AS BEGIN insert into @TC select fro_gidlp,naz_archiwalny from cdn.PicoStanowiska join cdn.PicoKonfig on PSa_PcKID = PcK_PicoID join cdn.FrmStruktura on PcK_CentrumID = FRS_ID join cdn.FrmObiekty on FRS_Id=FRO_FRMID join cdn.Nazwy on Naz_GIDLp = fro_gidlp AND Naz_GIDTyp = FRO_GIDTyp where FRO_GIDTyp = 64 and PSa_ID = @PointOfSaleId RETURN END
GRANT SELECT ON CDN.POS_TCNDoEksportu TO CDNRaport
